chapter.heading: Bildad: Man Cannot Be Righteous
chapter.v:
“Dominion and
awe belong to God;He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.

Can His
troops be numbered?On whom does His light not rise?

How then
can a man be just before God?How can one born of woman be pure?

If even
the moon does not shine,and the stars are not pure in His sight,

how much
less man, who is but a maggot,and the son of man, who is but a worm!”
